items.title: feat(mcpx): wire identity failover into the daemon call path (#8017)
items.body: Implements piece 1 of #8017 (daemon call-path wiring; follow-on to #7948, queue task 20062): - `mcpauth/toolresult.go` (new): translates an error `tools/call` result — or a call error's text — into an `*mcpauth.APIError` Classify can read (status extraction, soft markers, Retry-After). Successful results never translate, however rate-limit-shaped their content. - `pool/failover.go` (new): `Pool.Call` runs failover-configured servers through `Rotator.Do`. A soft block rotates the identity, the instance serving the key is respawned on the rotated credential (`ReleaseKey`; the fresh spawn's `resolveAuth` reads the persisted rotation state), and the call is retried — the calling session never sees the soft block. Hard blocks and all non-block outcomes settle byte-for-byte as before (sentinel the rotator treats as hard). `resolveAuth` and `Call` share one construction site (`failoverRotator`); rotations log through the pool lifecycle log naming both identities. - `pool.go`: existing `Call` body becomes `callOnce`; unused `net/http` import dropped. - `testsupport/fakemcp`: script responses gain `isError` results and an `ifEnv`/`else` conditional, so a fake's answer can depend on the credential it was spawned with. - `doc/fleet/mcp.md`: failover paragraph now describes the call path. Oracle tests (all pass on the laptop, post-rebase): - mcpauth translation: secondary-limit 403 rotates; 429 + Retry-After rotates; marker-less 403 is hard; a successful result about rate limits never translates; unrelated errors never translate. - pool end-to-end (`TestFailoverCallSoftBlockRotatesRespawnsAndRetries`): fake spawned with identity "first" soft-blocks; the caller sees only `served-by-second` and the persisted rotation state names "second". `TestFailoverCallHardBlockSurfacesUnchanged`: hard block returns unchanged, no rotation. - `go build ./...`, `go vet`, mcpauth + fakemcp suites pass. Full pool suite: one flaky failure in `TestDefaultConfigStdioRunsSupervised` (supervised-child reap timing under suite load) — passes standalone in this worktree and on clean main; unrelated to this change. Not in this PR — piece 2 (live activation) is split to a follow-on queue task with the evidence: the github server is absent from both the live `~/.config/mcpx/config.json` and the repo `.mcpx.json`, and no source checked (issue #8017, doc/fleet/mcp.md, #7948) names the three GitHub App identities / App IDs / installation IDs / secret-store names to enroll, so there is nothing well-defined to activate yet. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? items.title: feat(mcpx): GitHub identity failover for server auth (#7948)
items.body: Refs #7948 (queue task 14308). Follow-on: #8017. ## What landed **`pkgs/mcpx/internal/mcpauth/failover.go`** — the identity-failover machinery for a server's auth block: - **Config**: `auth.failover.identities` — an ordered list of identities, each referenced by **secret name only** (no secret value in config, logs, or comments). Kind `app` = GitHub App (App ID + installation ID in config; PEM private key in the secret store); kind `token` = a stored token, so the single user token stays as the last entry / fallback and a bad App config cannot take the namespace down. - **Classification** (`Classify`): soft = HTTP 429, or 403 carrying rate-limit markers (primary/secondary limit text incl. "submitted too quickly", abuse detection, or a Retry-After). Hard = 401, marker-less 403, 404, 422, anything else — surfaces immediately with its real error, zero rotation. - **Rotator** (`Rotator.Do`): runs a call with the current identity; on a soft block it cools that identity down, logs the rotation (identity name + reason), persists state, and retries with the next identity — the caller sees success. Current identity + cooldowns persist in a state file, so they survive a github-server restart. - **Minter**: signs the App JWT (RS256, iss = App ID, 9-minute exp under GitHub's cap) and exchanges it for an installation token; tokens are cached in memory until near expiry, never persisted. - **Pool wiring** (`internal/pool`): a server whose auth block carries a failover list resolves the **current** identity's credential at connection start (bearer header, plus the auth block's declared env vars for stdio children). Servers without a failover block are byte-for-byte untouched. - **Docs**: `doc/fleet/mcp.md` github section + inventory row updated to the identity-list credential shape. - Session-facing tool surface unchanged (no tool names/counts touched). ## Tests (named oracles, all passing on the laptop) - `TestSoftBlockFailsOverToSecondIdentity` — forced 429 and forced secondary-limit 403 on identity #1 both complete via identity #2; oracle = exact (identity, token) call sequence + rotation log line. - `TestHardBlockSurfacesImmediatelyWithNoRotation` — 401 / marker-less 403 / 404 / 422; oracle = exactly one call, zero rotation log lines, real error returned. - `TestRotationStateSurvivesRestart` — a second Rotator over the same state file reports the identical current identity and cooldown deadline. - `TestMintInstallationToken` — fake API; oracle = request path, JWT iss/lifetime, returned token. - `TestAppIdentityMintsAndCaches`, `TestAllIdentitiesSoftBlockedReturnsLastError`, `TestClassify` table. - `go test ./internal/mcpauth/ ./internal/pool/` pass; `go build ./...` clean. (`internal/config` has one failure, `TestServerKeysAnotherHostWritesAreRecordedNotRefused`, verified **pre-existing on clean main** faae727d5d — untouched by this PR.) ## What remains (#8017) Daemon call-path wiring (translate a github tool result's embedded API soft block into `APIError`, run through `Rotator.Do`, respawn + retry mid-session) and live activation (enroll the App keys by name, add the failover block to the live github server config). #7948 stays open for that follow-on; this PR deliberately does not close it. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: build(atlas-search): cf deploy toolchain deps (#8625)
items.body: ## What Deploy-toolchain deps for the atlas-search Worker's cf versions flow (#8625), companion to #12785 (MCP endpoint) and #12790 (cloudflare.config.ts): - `cf` 1.0.0-beta.20 added as a devDependency — `cloudflare.config.ts` imports `cf/config`, which must resolve from the project (the pin `pkgs/pkarr-worker` and `pkgs/message-bridge` use). - wrangler exact pin 4.59.1 → 4.152.0 — the `cf` CLI delegates builds to the project's wrangler and requires ≥ 4.136.0 for the delegate (4.152.0 is `pkgs/pkarr-worker`'s pin). - Lockfile regenerated; `deploy` script now points at the cf flow (`cf workers versions create`). ## Verification Worker suite **31/31 pass** and `tsc --noEmit` clean on the new toolchain (laptop worktree). No source changes. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
